crossRefs.note: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell…
I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in…
His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Lazarus
people.line: Brother of Mary and Martha; raised from the dead

translations.web: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.
translations.bsb: So Jesus told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead,
translations.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
translations.asv: Then Jesus therefore said unto them plainly, Lazarus is dead.
